controller.text: Controller: to be named before the pilot launch. Until then, write to <email>{{email}}</email> with any question about your data.
controller.title: Who is responsible

data.text: Account: name, username, e-mail and a password hash, to sign you in. Profile: role, topics, days and times, the place you pick on the map (rounded to about 1 km) and your note, to suggest kvintets. Kvintet and chat: your seat, votes and messages, to run the group. For these we rely on the contract you enter by using Kvintet. Sign-in sessions keep your IP address and browser details, to keep you signed in and to prevent abuse. Under a pseudonym we record which kvintets you were shown, which one you joined and how long you stayed, to improve the suggestions. We do this in our legitimate interest, and you can object (see your rights).
data.title: What we keep and why

recipients.text: Other members see your role and topics, and your name and username only once your kvintet starts. The admin sees totals and a file of matching data in which you appear only as a pseudonym. The app runs on hosting in the EU. The map on the place page loads tiles from OpenStreetMap, which sees your IP address and the area you look at.
recipients.title: Who can see it

retention.text: Account and profile: until you delete your account. Matching data: at most one year, or until you delete your account, after which it is no longer linked to you. Sign-in sessions: until they expire. Messages you wrote stay in your kvintet without your name when you delete your account, so the others can still follow the conversation; they disappear when the kvintet is gone.
retention.title: How long we keep it

rights.text: You can download your data and edit your profile on your profile page, and delete your account there. To change your name, username or e-mail, to object to the matching record, or to ask anything else, write to <email>{{email}}</email>; we answer within one month. You can also complain to the Office for Personal Data Protection (ÚOOÚ), uoou.gov.cz.
rights.title: Your rights

sensitive.text: Please leave health, religion, political views and other sensitive details out of your note, a kvintet description and the chat. Kvintet does not need them.
